title: Kindle Highlight Density by Book
dataSources: Highlights (`reading:highlight`), book activity (`reading:book`), reviews (`reading:review`), paper libraries (`research:paper`), sync states (`reading:sync`).
app: Reading and second-brain telemetry — Readwise review exports, Kindle highlights, Goodreads shelves, and Zotero research libraries — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reading:highlight source_app="kindle" book_title=* highlights_per_100_pages=*
| stats avg(highlights_per_100_pages) as avg_highlights_per_100_pages, count as events by book_title
| sort - avg_highlights_per_100_pages
description: Shows average highlights per 100 pages by book for Kindle annotation density.
value: Average highlights per 100 pages by book helps compare Kindle annotation density across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `highlights_per_100_pages` on `reading:highlight` events and normalize `book_title` so Splunk can summarize performance by book.
visualization: Bar chart of average highlights per 100 pages by book.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals the average highlights per 100 pages for each book so you can see what works best for Kindle annotation density.
